name: A Hunter's Boast
summary: A Hunter's Boast is a timed hunting challenge issued by Daryl the Youngling at Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan. Eager to flaunt his supposed mastery, the arrogant young human dares adventurers to track and slay six mountain buzzards before his fifteen-minute timer expires.

sections.title: A Young Marksman's Arrogance
sections.body: Farstrider Lodge serves as a gathering ground for some of Khaz Modan's finest trackers and marksmen, but not everyone under its roof possesses veteran humility. Daryl the Youngling—who fancies himself 'Daryl the Bold'—is quick to dismiss wandering adventurers. Convinced that greenhorn outsiders cannot hold a candle to his own hunting prowess, he lays down a brash wager: bag half a dozen local mountain buzzards within a quarter of an hour, or admit defeat.

sections.title: Thinning the Scavengers
sections.body: Mountain buzzards circle the crags and hillsides of Loch Modan, scavenging scraps and preying on smaller wildlife. While dangerous in numbers, they serve primarily as a baseline test of a hunter's speed, patience, and aim. Those who bring down the required quarry within the strict time limit quickly deflate Daryl's puffed-up pride, forcing him to reluctantly part with one of his ranged weapons and setting the stage for further hunting dares.

faq.q: Where does this hunting challenge take place?
faq.answer: The quest begins at Farstrider Lodge, situated in the southeastern wilderness of Loch Modan. The mountain buzzards you must hunt roam the nearby crags and open ridges across the zone.

Daryl the Youngling is an ambitious, boastful young human staying at Farstrider Lodge. Calling himself 'Daryl the Bold,' he enjoys taunting travelers into timed hunting trials to prove his own imagined superiority.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on the hunt?
faq.answer: The fifteen-minute restriction is part of Daryl's wager. He believes that taking down wild buzzards under pressure is a feat well beyond an ordinary adventurer's skill.

faq.q: What happens after beating Daryl's challenge?
faq.answer: Though shocked by your success, Daryl refuses to admit true defeat. He honors his wager by offering a weapon, then immediately offers another hunting task—A Hunter's Challenge—targeting larger game.
Flocks of mountain buzzards nest around Loch Modan's rocky slopes. They serve as an agile, flying target ideal for testing whether an archer or rifleman has genuine field discipline.

faq.q: Does this quest tie into the rest of Farstrider Lodge's tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Daryl's tests lead directly into a broader sequence of hunts for the lodge, culminating in tracking down Ol' Sooty, the bear that scarred Daryl, as part of Vyrin Swiftwind's plan to get back at the boastful youngster.

angles.text: For marksmen and trackers, Daryl's contest is an amusing chance to outshoot a boasting novice on his home turf and claim a reliable bow or gun.
Dwarves used to the lodge's seasoned hunters will recognize this human youngster's posturing as empty bravado, best answered with quiet competence.
Farstrider Lodge serves as an important Alliance outpost along the southeastern roads of Loch Modan, providing shelter and staging hunts across the rugged valleys.
